summary: Checked all 159 CON items. Critical fixes: (1) the new 'Brennan and Panetta, 25' claim that ex-CIA directors said in 2025 videos that Trump 'does not have NATO's back' could not be verified (Brennan's March 2025 Times Radio remarks were about the Ukraine intel pause; Panetta's Article 5 remarks were a BILD print interview in Aug 2026; Bjorn Beam never says it), so constructive para 2, con_reb_19 and c_pf_55 now use Brennan's verified remark plus Trump's own 'If they don't pay, I'm not going to defend them' (AP, Mar 6 2025), and the chip/trigger/topic labels no longer promise such a video; the Brennan & Panetta card itself should be replaced (see newSources). (2) con_reb_23 said no TPNW party borders Russia: Kazakhstan does (fixed to European neighbours). (3) con_reb_29 reintroduced the Article 17 'forbids withdrawing in war' error. (4) con_reb_22 'nuclear posture under 3% of NATO spending' is false (ICAN 2026: US+UK+France about $89.5bn = about 5.7% of SIPRI's $1,581bn) and the van Hooft cost claim was misattributed (now Bruegel, 25). (5) con_reb_20 said every false alarm was Soviet/Russian (NORAD 1979/80) and pinned de-targeting on Band, 09 (now UK MoD, 98). Recurring fixes reapplied: Jones 'multi-year' (x3), 'conventional' 8-to-1, Ukraine 'agreed in 1994', 'nuclear-armed NATO' -> 'territory covered by Article 5', 515 'submarine' warheads (about 50 French are air-launched), NAC 2020 exact wording / 30 allies, no 'incompatible' in NAC 2020 or 2026 (that is NATO, 23), 'air-gapped' and 'physically impossible' removed, Lewis, 14 not a no-radiation source. SIPRI Yearbook 2026 says Russia's stockpile was stable (modernizing); only China and North Korea are expanding (5 items). Finland's June 2026 vote re-sourced from Defense News (a March article) to Euronews, 26. NATO Strategic Concept says 'unacceptable' costs, not 'infinite'. UK submarines are at 'several days notice to fire', not 'minutes'. Ottawa: Finland and Poland have already withdrawn. Kahn, not 'Kahn and Schelling'.
